main.description: Metadata for an individual long-form document published to the web. Vendored subset of site.standard.document.

site.description: AT-URI of the site.standard.publication this document belongs to

path.description: URL path segment for the document on the publication

description.description: Short plaintext excerpt for cross-tool preview

textContent.description: Plaintext rendering of the body for cross-tool preview (must not contain markdown)

content.description: Open content union; opnshelf reviews carry an at.markpub.markdown member

links.description: Open links union; opnshelf reviews carry an xyz.opnshelf.mediaLink member binding the document to a media item
